environment.note: all three defects are Windows-only; Ubuntu CI cannot reach them

handoff_error_distribution.description: 5 threads contending on one lock for 3 seconds, counting what the exclusive create reported and whether the lock file was visible at that instant
handoff_error_distribution.interpretation: permission_denied_file_absent is the delete-pending window between a holder's unlink and the directory entry going away; three stores read it as proof the lock was unreachable and failed the caller

stat_during_delete_pending.description: what stat() reports when the exclusive create has just been refused
stat_during_delete_pending.interpretation: stat never raised PermissionError, so the existing FileNotFoundError handling was sufficient there

poll_strategy_comparison.description: 20 threads, 1 ms critical section, 2 s timeout, 5 runs per strategy
poll_strategy_comparison.rejected_backoff_because: per-waiter backoff starves the longest waiter, which is the one that times out: its worst wait was 578 ms against 96 ms for a constant short poll

merge_jobs_twenty_writers.description: the real merge_jobs write path, 20 threads, 2 s timeout, idle machine
